name: AstroImpact
tagline: A multi-player space game, defend the planet from the incoming asteroids!
blurb: Play with friends online to defend the planet!
description:
Play with friends online to defend the planet! Longest time to first impact or
longest time to 100% damage. You destroy asteroids by flying into them before they hit the planet!

• Escape to free mouse lock.

• Use W,A,S,D,Q,E,SPACE & LEFT SHIFT to move around.

• L-CTRL / Right Click to Brake.

• L-ALT / Mouse 3/4 Click to Instant Brake.

• R = Toggle auto-tilt/roll around planet.

• Q+E to stop rolling.

• F = FPS to console.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
